结构与过程示意 · 颜色和时间经过调整: Structure and process models · Colour and time are adjusted
身体里的细胞为什么长得不一样？: Why do body cells have different shapes?
皮肤细胞连成保护层，肌肉纤维能收缩，神经元把信息传向远处。同样叫细胞，本领却不一: Skin cells build a barrier, muscle fibres contract, and neurons pass information over long distances. All are cells, with different abilities.
比较皮肤、肌肉与神经元，观察形状怎样帮助它们保护、运动和传递信息。: Compare skin, muscle and neurons. See how structure supports protection, movement and communication.
这是三类代表结构的比较，不是人体全部细胞清单。大小、颜色、速度和图中层数均为示意: These are three representative structures, not a complete inventory of body cells. Size, colour, speed and layer counts are illustrative, without the staining meaning of a micrograph. The muscle view combines fibres with one sarcomere to show sliding, not shortening filaments; forces that restore length are not modeled. The neuron example uses a myelinated axon and chemical synapse, not every neuronal form.
细胞与组织的互动示意图: Interactive illustration of cells and tissues
观察层层相接的细胞。外面的标记遇到完整表面停住了；屏障并不是只有一颗细胞在工作。: Observe cells joined in layers. External markers stop at the intact surface; the barrier is not the work of one cell alone.
皮肤表皮里，许多细胞相接排列。靠外的细胞逐渐扁平、角化，参与形成保护屏障。: Many cells join to form the epidermis. Cells nearer the surface flatten and become cornified, contributing to a protective barrier.
这里选定的外来颗粒被完整表面挡住。皮肤不是一堵完全不透任何东西的墙，但能减少许多: The selected particles are blocked by the intact surface. Skin is not impermeable to everything, but it limits many external materials and water loss.
表皮深处有细胞分裂并向表面补充。最外层角化细胞没有细胞核，不能把每一层都当成一样: Cells deeper in the epidermis divide and replenish the surface. The outermost cornified cells lack nuclei; not every layer consists of identical living cells.
拖到中间看收缩，再拖到最后看放松。放大图里的细丝没有变短，而是彼此滑动，重叠增加: Scrub to the middle for contraction and to the end for relaxation. In the close view, filaments slide and overlap more; the filaments themselves do not shorten.
一条骨骼肌纤维就是一个很长的细胞，通常有多个细胞核。里面排着许多参与收缩的结构。: A skeletal muscle fibre is one very long cell, usually with multiple nuclei. It contains many structures involved in contraction.
收到适合的信号后，钙离子参与调节，肌动蛋白与肌球蛋白相互作用。这里仅把相对滑动放: Following an appropriate signal, calcium helps regulate interactions between actin and myosin. This close view isolates their relative sliding.
收缩需要能量；停止激活后，肌纤维可以放松。实际恢复长度还受到其他肌肉、弹性和外部: Contraction uses energy. After activation stops, the fibre can relax. Its actual return in length also depends on other muscles, elasticity and external loads.
沿长长的轴突追踪亮点，再看突触附近的小点。亮点是信号位置标记，并不是在神经里奔跑: Follow the bright marker along the axon, then watch the small dots near the synapse. The bright spot marks a signal; it is not a ball running inside a nerve.
神经元有细胞体和突起。很多树突参与接收信息，轴突可以把信号传到较远的位置。: A neuron has a cell body and extensions. Many dendrites receive information, while an axon can carry signals farther away.
信号沿膜传开: A signal spreads along the membrane
离子通过膜上的通道，形成沿轴突传播的电变化。图中髓鞘来自其他细胞，能帮助某些轴突: Ions pass through membrane channels, producing an electrical change that travels along the axon. Myelin comes from other cells and speeds conduction in some axons.
在这个化学突触例子中，末梢释放递质。递质跨过很窄的间隙，影响下一个细胞，而不是两: In this chemical-synapse example, the ending releases neurotransmitter. It crosses a tiny gap and affects the next cell; the two cells do not form one continuous pipe.
细胞的长短、排列、内部结构和连接方式，都与它做的事有关。形状不是按任务临时随意换: Length, arrangement, internal structures and connections all support function. Cells do not simply switch costumes to take a new job.
皮肤、肌肉和神经组织都不只有图中挑出的细胞。支持细胞、血管和细胞外物质也很重要。: Skin, muscle and nervous tissues contain more than the selected cells shown. Supporting cells, vessels and extracellular material also matter.
拿起一块积木时，神经传信息、肌肉产生力，皮肤保护表面；血液还持续运输氧气和营养。: When you pick up a block, nerves convey information, muscles generate force, and skin protects the surface. Blood continually carries oxygen and nutrients.
红细胞留在血管内: Red cells stay inside the vessel
骨骼肌纤维：细丝滑动，整体变短: Muscle: sliding filaments shorten the fibre
放大看：细丝长度不变，重叠增加: Close view: fixed-length filaments overlap more
神经元：结构连得远，信号传得快: A neuron: long connections carry signals
信号沿膜传播，再把信息传给下一个细胞: A membrane signal passes information to the next cell
先找到两端的连接，再比较允许缩短和固定长度。停在同一激活进度，观察长度、外部弹簧: Find both end connections, then compare shortening with fixed length. Pause at the same activation progress to inspect length, the external spring and force arrows. Look for the external pull that restores length.
肌肉、连接组织与外部弹性负载: Muscle, connective tissue and an elastic load
放大同一纤维的代表肌节：细丝长度不变: A representative sarcomere in the same fibre: filament lengths stay fixed
比较同一激活阶段的两种约束: Compare two constraints at the same activation stage
两次对照从各自相同的预拉起点开始。改约束会暂停并保留激活进度，不表示真实装置瞬间: Both constraint comparisons begin at the same preloaded length for the selected spring. Changing the constraint pauses and retains activation progress; it does not represent an instantaneous physical switch.
连接点受力：玫瑰箭头向左是肌肉总张力；绿色向右是外部弹簧力；蓝灰向右是固定夹具的: Forces on the junction: the rose arrow points left for total muscle tension; green points right for the external spring; blue-grey points right for the clamp reaction. All arrows share one relative force scale.
上方是带连接组织的肌肉与装置，下方是同一纤维中的代表肌节；放大比例不同。: Above is muscle with connective tissue and the apparatus; below is a representative sarcomere in the same fibre. The magnifications differ.
激活减弱，外部弹簧拉回: Less activation: the external spring pulls back
左端固定，肌肉通过连接组织连到右边的弹簧。弹簧已经轻轻拉着它，所以还没激活时也有: The left end is fixed. Connective tissue links the muscle to the spring on the right. The spring already pulls gently, so tension is present before activation.
右端夹具把长度锁住，肌肉仍在产生张力。看看向右的夹具反力：没有缩短，不等于没有用: The right-hand clamp fixes length while the muscle still produces tension. Inspect the rightward clamp reaction: no shortening does not mean no force.
肌肉拉着连接点向左，外面的弹簧被拉长。把弹簧调硬：同样的激活下，缩短更少，总张力: The muscle pulls the junction left, stretching the external spring. Make the spring stiffer: at the same activation, shortening is smaller and total tension is greater.
激活正在减弱，外部弹簧把连接点向右拉回。放松不是肌肉主动向外推；这里的回长依赖看: As activation decreases, the external spring pulls the junction back to the right. Relaxation is not an active outward push; length is restored by the visible external pull.
两个端点不移动，为什么力箭头仍会变化？: Why do the force arrows change while both endpoints stay still?
把弹簧调软，再停在同一进度：缩短量怎样变了？: Soften the spring and pause at the same progress. How does the amount of shortening change?
相对读数：长度为起点的 {{length}}%；总张力 {{tension}}；: Relative readings: length is {{length}}% of its initial value; total tension {{tension}}; external spring force {{spring}}; clamp reaction {{clamp}}.
固定夹具锁住本模型的肌肉端点；不伸长的肌腱只传力。激活使有效参考长度变短，总张力: The clamp fixes this model’s muscle endpoint; inextensible tendons transmit force. Activation reduces the effective reference length and increases total tension. The external spring keeps its length, so the clamp supplies the additional balancing force. Real muscle and tendon are compliant: a fixed overall length does not guarantee that every sarcomere stays still.
允许右端移动时，每个观察状态都满足准静态平衡：肌肉总张力等于外部弹簧力。激活缩短: With the right endpoint free, each observation state satisfies quasi-static balance: total muscle tension equals external spring force. Activation shortens the effective reference length, moving the endpoint left and stretching the spring, which increases its pull. This is not a constant-force load or an isotonic contraction. The control changes spring stiffness, not weight.
L 是本模型的肌肉长度，L* 是随激活改变的有效参考长度；Lᵢ 是预拉起点的长度: L is model muscle length, L* the effective reference length changed by activation, and Lᵢ the initial preloaded length. T is total tension, Fₑ external spring force, R clamp reaction; kₘ and kₑ are teaching stiffnesses, and s−s₀ is external spring extension.
这是慢速、无惯性的有效弹性收缩模型，使用屏幕长度与相对力单位；参数不是生理测量。: This is a slow, inertia-free effective elastic contraction model using screen lengths and relative force units, not physiological measurements. It begins with passive preload but does not separate real active and passive force contributions. Cross-bridges, tendon extension, length and velocity dependence, fatigue and active lengthening are not solved. The stiffest setting is not an overload case.
